comunicacao.js: (async () => { const espera = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const abrirGrupo = async () => { [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Adicionar widget').click(); await espera(700); const d = document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'); const el = [...d.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(x => x.children.length < 6 && x.innerText && x.innerText.startsWith('Comunicação\n')).pop(); (el.closest('button,[role=button],a,li') || el).click(); await espera(700); return d }; const add = async nome => { let d = document.querySelector('[role=dialog]') || await abrirGrupo(); const b = [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(x => x.innerText.trim() === 'Adicionar').find(x => { let p = x.parentElement; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { if (p.innerText.split('\n')[0].trim() === nome) return true; p = p.parentElement } return false }); b.click(); await espera(900) }; [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Personalizar').click(); await espera(700); for (const n of ['SMS', 'WhatsApp', 'E-mail']) await add(n); [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Concluir').click() })()
